{
  "name": "loss_softplus_advantage_ratio",
  "intuition": "Instead of margin-based logits difference, use a ratio-scaled advantage signal modulated by softplus to encourage smooth and robust preference alignment with advantage normalization; this softplus-ratio paradigm shifts from margin thresholds to smooth penalty on inverse advantage ratios.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_ratio = (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) / (abs(advantage_gap) + epsilon)\nscaled = scale * adv_ratio\nloss = softplus(-scaled) * weight\nreturn mean(loss)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "ratio_based",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "softplus",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "softplus",
    "abs",
    "add",
    "div",
    "mul",
    "neg",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": ["log_prob_w", "log_prob_l", "weight", "advantage_gap"],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 1.5))\n    eps = 1e-6\n    adv_ratio = (lpw - lpl) / (ops.abs(adv_gap) + eps)\n    scaled = scale * adv_ratio\n    loss = ops.softplus(-scaled)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = loss * weight\n    return ops.mean(loss)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_advantage_hinge_custom",
  "intuition": "margin-based hinge loss leveraging advantage signals to enforce a wide margin between winning and losing log-probs, promoting robust preference modeling beyond soft probabilistic constraints.",
  "pseudocode": "margin = alpha * advantage_gap; diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l; loss = mean(weight * relu(margin - diff))",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_hinge",

    "link_family": "relu",
    "agg_family": "mean",

  },

  ],

    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_gap"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    margin = ops.mul(alpha, adv_gap)\n    diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    hinge = ops.relu(ops.sub(margin, diff))\n    if weight is not None:\n        hinge = ops.mul(hinge, weight)\n    return ops.mean(hinge)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_pairwise_contrastive_000_advantage",
  "intuition": "Contrastive pairwise loss that transforms the advantage gap into a smooth similarity score and applies a hinge-like margin with an exponential weighting, enabling nonlinear penalty emphasizing large advantage discrepancies.",
  "pseudocode": "adv_gap = batch['advantage_w'] - batch['advantage_l']\nscore_diff = batch['log_prob_w'] - batch['log_prob_l']\nmargin = 1.0\nweight_adj = exp(-adv_gap * adv_gap)\nloss_per_pair = relu(margin - score_diff * tanh(adv_gap)) * weight_adj\nif weight is not None:\n    loss_per_pair *= weight\nfinal_loss = mean(loss_per_pair)",
  "hyperparams": {
    "paradigm_family": "pairwise_contrastive",
    "signal_family": "advantage_gap",
    "link_family": "relu_tanh_exp",
    "agg_family": "mean",
    "constraint_family": "none"
  },
  "operators_used": [
    "exp",
    "relu",
    "tanh",
    "sub",
    "mul",
    "mean"
  ],
  "implementation_hint": {
    "expects": [
      "log_prob_w",
      "log_prob_l",
      "weight",
      "advantage_w",
      "advantage_l"
    ],
    "returns": "scalar",
    "mode": "pairwise"
  },
  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    adv_w = batch['advantage_w']\n    adv_l = batch['advantage_l']\n    adv_gap = ops.sub(adv_w, adv_l)\n    score_diff = ops.sub(lpw, lpl)\n    margin = 1.0\n    weight_adj = ops.exp(ops.neg(ops.mul(adv_gap, adv_gap)))\n    margin_diff = ops.sub(margin, ops.mul(score_diff, ops.tanh(adv_gap)))\n    loss_per_pair = ops.relu(margin_diff)\n    loss_per_pair = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight_adj)\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss_per_pair = ops.mul(loss_per_pair, weight)\n    return ops.mean(loss_per_pair)"
}

{
  "name": "loss_rank_gap_plus_logsigmoid_advantage",
  "intuition": "Repaired to break similarity by incorporating a different quality signal advantage_gap combined multiplicatively with the logit difference (log_prob_w - log_prob_l), replacing the original cost-gap component. Added a rank_gap term to incorporate ordinal information and diversify the signal. This hybrid approach leverages advantage_gap and rank_gap signals for improved learning dynamics and novelty, while retaining the original logsigmoid link and clamping for numeric stability.",
  "pseudocode": "rank_loss = ops.rank_gap(batch['log_prob_w'], batch['log_prob_l'])\nadv_term = alpha * scale * (log_prob_w - log_prob_l) * advantage_gap\nx = ops.clamp(adv_term, -20, 20)\nloss = -ops.logsigmoid(x) + beta * rank_loss\nif weight: loss *= weight\nloss = loss.mean()",

  "code": "def generated_loss(batch, model_output, extra):\n    lpw = batch['log_prob_w']\n    lpl = batch['log_prob_l']\n    adv_gap = batch['advantage_gap']\n    weight = batch.get('weight', None)\n    alpha = float(extra.get('alpha', extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('alpha', 1.0)))\n    scale = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('scale', 2.0))\n    beta = float(extra.get('hyperparams', {}).get('beta', 0.5))\n    rank_loss = ops.rank_gap(lpw, lpl)\n    adv_term = alpha * scale * ops.mul(ops.sub(lpw, lpl), adv_gap)\n    x = ops.clamp(adv_term, -20.0, 20.0)\n    loss = ops.neg(ops.logsigmoid(x))\n    loss = ops.add(loss, ops.mul(beta, rank_loss))\n    if weight is not None:\n        loss = ops.mul(loss, weight)\n    return loss.mean()"
